name: global-solar-atlas
title: Global Solar Atlas, long-term average solar resource and air temperature
description: Long-term yearly averages of global horizontal irradiation (GHI), direct normal irradiation (DNI) and air temperature at 2 m (TEMP), plus the accompanying diffuse, tilted, elevation and PV-output layers, as global GeoTIFFs at roughly 250 m to 1 km. Produced by Solargis for the World Bank / ESMAP Global Solar Atlas. RESKit's PV workflows use GHI and DNI to bias-correct ERA5 irradiance; the CSP workflows use DNI and TEMP to pick the optimal heat transfer fluid per placement. Holds three GSA vintages, one per sub-directory -- see ethos:shard_depth.

ethos:upstream.note: Checked 2026-09-07. The v2 layers are served from api.globalsolaratlas.info/download/World/ and were re-downloaded successfully. The URLs are not discoverable on the GSA site itself -- they are listed in the CKAN catalogue at energydata.info (ESMAP/World Bank) -- and the host answers 404 to HEAD while serving GET, which makes them look dead when probed casually. The 2017 v1 rasters under global_solar_atlas/ are a different matter: that vintage is no longer offered and was not re-checked.
